name: Microsoft Entra ID Protection
short_description: Microsoft Entra ID Protection detects, investigates and remediates identity-based risks by scoring sign-in risk and user risk, which Conditional Access policies can use to require MFA, a password change or block access.

evidence.quote: Microsoft Enter ID protection is the part of Microsoft's cloud that watches those sign ins
Microsoft Entra ID protection can help surface risky workload activity
identity protection generates risk signals for users who might be compromised.
identity protection does the profiling work no human has time to do
